title: Take responsibility for a mistake
prompt: Describe a mistake you made on a project and how you handled it. A class or personal project is a valid example. Explain the impact, your own actions, and what changed afterward.
followUps: How and when did you communicate the mistake?
What did you do to reduce its impact?
What evidence shows your prevention step worked?

twist.prompt: Suppose you discover the mistake just before a deadline and fixing it risks missing that deadline. How do you communicate the trade-off?
